title: 3-Hour Study With Me 🌧️ Rainy Night Desk · Pomodoro 3 × 50/10 with Motivation
description:
Study with me for 3 focused hours at a cozy rainy-night desk. 🌧️ A small timer sits quietly in the corner, and gentle motivational messages fade in now and then to keep you going. Music plays only in the breaks — during focus you hear nothing but soft rain.

⏱️ FORMAT
• 3 sessions × (50 min focus / 10 min break)
• 10-second countdown to begin
• Minimal corner timer (no big distracting clock)
• Soft motivational messages with a gentle chime, every ~10 minutes
• 🎵 Music ONLY during breaks — while you focus, just quiet rain

🕖 TIMESTAMPS
00:00 — Intro & 10-second countdown
00:14 — Session 1 · Focus 50:00
50:14 — Break 10:00 (music)
1:00:14 — Session 2 · Focus 50:00
1:50:14 — Break 10:00 (music)
2:00:14 — Session 3 · Focus 50:00
2:50:14 — Break 10:00 (music)
3:00:14 — Well done 🎉

🎧 Best with headphones. Put your phone away and let's get things done.

🌱 Like & subscribe for more study-with-me timers and deep-focus sessions.

Ambience from public-domain / Creative Commons sources.
